params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$repo='C:\Users\Xxkan\mhw-mods-work-canonical'
$wt='C:\Users\Xxkan\AppData\Local\Temp\mhw-workflows-final-int'
$branch='integration/complete-mod-workflows-final-20260929'
git -C $repo fetch origin --prune | Out-Null
if(Test-Path $wt){ git -C $repo worktree remove --force $wt | Out-Null }
git -C $repo show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/heads/$branch"
if($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0){ git -C $repo branch -D $branch | Out-Null }
git -C $repo worktree add -b $branch $wt origin/main | Out-Null
Set-Location $wt
$base=(git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()

git cherry-pick -n 02fa1dd5c3e98d319067043598bfdfd32617e65f
$cpExit=$LASTEXITCODE
$conflicts=@(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U)

# Current main wins all textual conflicts initially; cleanly-applicable implementation hunks/new files stay.
foreach($p in $conflicts){ git checkout --ours -- $p | Out-Null; git add -- $p | Out-Null }

# Never import stale release/continuity/verification/CI state from the old branch.
$stale=@(
 '.github/workflows/windows-workflows.yml',
 '.gitignore',
 '.verification/function-status.json',
 'CHANGELOG.md',
 'README.md',
 '_AGENT_CONTEXT'
)
foreach($p in $stale){ if(Test-Path $p){ git restore --source=HEAD --staged --worktree -- $p | Out-Null } }

git add -A
$diffcheckCode=0
git diff --cached --check
$diffcheckCode=$LASTEXITCODE

$autoOut=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mhw-workflows-auto-test.log'
$appOut=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mhw-workflows-app-build.log'
& dotnet test 'tests\MhwModManager.AutomationTests\MhwModManager.AutomationTests.csproj' -c Release *> $autoOut
$auto=$LASTEXITCODE
& dotnet build 'src\MhwModManager.App\MhwModManager.App.csproj' -c Release *> $appOut
$app=$LASTEXITCODE

$status=@(git status --short)
$stat=(git diff --cached --stat | Out-String).Trim()
$autoTail=(Get-Content -LiteralPath $autoOut -Tail 100 | Out-String).Trim()
$appTail=(Get-Content -LiteralPath $appOut -Tail 100 | Out-String).Trim()
[ordered]@{
 base=$base
 cherry_pick_exit=$cpExit
 conflicts_resolved_with_current_main=$conflicts
 diff_check_exit=$diffcheckCode
 automation_test_exit=$auto
 app_build_exit=$app
 diff_stat=$stat
 status=$status
 automation_tail=$autoTail
 app_build_tail=$appTail
 worktree=$wt
 branch=$branch
} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
exit 0
